title: God in Nederland 1979
contributors: NOVUM bv * HaarlemWeekblad De Tijd KRO * Hilversum (research initiator)
Intomart bv * HilversumInteract bv * Dongen (data collector)
descriptions: Opinions of Dutch citizens about religion, church and clergy. Matters of religion / church and clergy / general issues contraceptives / apartheid / homosexuality / mixed marriage / nuclear weapons / abortion / divorce / euthanasia / affinity with sects and movements. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
